expected_failures.two_supplied_one_cited: Unchanged production returned Rejected/durable-binding-mismatch instead of committing the valid cited subset.
expected_failures.two_supplied_none_cited: Unchanged production returned Rejected/durable-binding-mismatch instead of committing when the valid supplied authorization set was uncited.

passing_controls.two_supplied_all_cited: Committed successfully and exact replay returned the same immutable document version and commit fingerprint.
passing_controls.supplied_binding_drift: Missing current Pre-Scan Result, wrong current Pre-Scan Result, and an uncited supplied field mismatch were rejected as durable-binding-mismatch with zero graph/count mutation and a Running job.
passing_controls.cited_unsupplied: The existing parser authority rejected an unsupplied cited ID as invalid-authoritative-result with zero mutation.

isolation: Fixture-owned disposable PostgreSQL databases were cleaned after each case; ordinary vulgata was not used or mutated.
privacy: The deterministic RED used no provider, source transfer, host/system, network, workflow, credential, or Git operation. The administrator connection is sanitized.
summary: T172 is compile-clean and behaviorally RED only for valid cited-subset and uncited supplied-set commits, isolating the cited-only durable-row query in the unchanged committer.
